_note: The fun pass's things to find (Ashwin, 2026-11-03, fun pass fix 3: exploring pays; lane C). Per place: `containers` where they would really stand (an `owner` makes taking from it stealing; `no_random_loot` keeps a household's chest out of the place's random magic items, story/treasure.gd, so the hub isn't a magic shop for burglars), `finds` (search props a Search turns up, Perception or, with `skill: investigation`, a hidden compartment), and `traps` (a quiet corner nobody walks through, or a container's `trap` round every square you open it from). tools/content/place_fun_finds.py lays them into data/locations and writes the cells it chose back here; `area` and `near` say where to look for a cell. Hand loot is mundane: coins, gems, potions, scrolls and keepsakes of our own (data/items, not for sale: shop_stock.json); magic items come from the engine's random pool by the place's level (levels.json region_levels). Texts drafted by Gemini, docs/plans/gemini_fun_finds/.

containers.label: The barber's drawer of razors and tips

finds.label: A crooked wicker charm behind the jars
finds.text: Behind those rows of hair in labelled jars, you pull out a crooked six-pointed star of twisted wicker. Still smells of fresh lamp smoke, like somebody just tucked it away.

containers.label: A locked display case of old books

finds.label: A false drawer in the writing table
finds.text: That writing table drawer is a mite too shallow, and its false bottom lifts on a page torn from an old catalogue. Unfold the paper, and a polished black onyx rolls into your palm.

finds.label: A loose flagstone before the altar
finds.text: One flagstone before the altar rocks under your boot heel. Down in the dirt beneath sits a dented tin of old offering coins, gone green with the years.

containers.label: A blanket chest at the foot of the bed

finds.label: A sock stuffed up the chimney
finds.text: Up inside the cold chimney, you hook a finger round a nail and bring down a wool sock black with soot. It hangs heavy with the clink of coins.

containers.label: A sewing basket by the loom
A feed bin under the coops
Mori's locked cabinet of burial money
A chest of shrouds and grave goods

finds.label: A loose brick behind the casks
finds.text: Back behind the casks, one brick sits proud of the cellar wall and slides right into your hand. Tucked in the gap is a heavy roll of old coins wrapped in waxed paper.

finds.label: A false back in the mayor's desk
finds.text: The back panel of the desk looks a hair too thick, and sure enough, it slides aside under your thumb. Wrapped in a folded handkerchief waits a heavy oak-leaf signet ring.

containers.label: A cider barrel by the farmhouse
A box of things taken off the pupils
A salt box under the block
A crate of horseshoes and nails

finds.label: A note pinned under the hay
finds.text: Under the dry hay, a horseshoe nail pins a folded note to the floorboard. Whoever wrote those big, slow letters took their sweet time doin' it.

containers.label: A chest of paints and brushes
A crate washed up on the bank

finds.label: A loose stone in the well's rim
finds.text: One stone on the well rim shifts loose when you lean your weight against it. Tucked in the damp mortar behind it is a yellow citrine, hidden for a rainy day that never came.

finds.label: A purse caught in the reeds
finds.text: Down in the river reeds, a little leather purse hangs caught by its drawstring. It is river-cold in your hand, with the coins still waitin' inside.

containers.label: A feed bin in the barn
A crate of the Druskenvalds' unpacked things

finds.label: A tin buried by the dead tree
finds.text: By the roots of the dead tree, your fingers scrape through turned earth to a rusted tin. Inside lie tarnished silver spoons, each handle stamped with an old letter L.

traps.label: A rusted jaw trap in the long grass
traps.text: From the long grass, rusted iron jaws clamp shut round your leg with a dull crunch.

traps.label: A rusted jaw trap by the barn wall
traps.text: Beside the barn wall, rusted iron springs from the dirt and bites hard into your shin.

containers.label: A curio cabinet of dusty knick-knacks
A pantry crate under the fallen shelf
A desk drawer under the books
A weasel's hoard of teeth and buttons

trap.label: A tooth-jawed snare round the hoard
trap.text: Right by the scatter of buttons and teeth, iron jaws studded with human molars snap shut on your ankle.

containers.label: A trunk of outgrown baby things

finds.label: A loose hearthstone in the parlour
finds.text: Under the cobwebbed fireplace, a loose hearthstone lifts out of the ash. Beneath it lies a tarnished silver locket, the tiny portrait inside scratched clean away.

finds.label: A book with its pages cut hollow
finds.text: A heavy volume on the saggin' shelf sits wrong in your hands. Its pages are cut hollow round a single large pearl.

finds.label: Something wedged behind the grandfather clock
finds.text: Wedged tight behind the ticking grandfather clock, your fingers brush a scrap of cloth. Inside the rag rests a cold yellow citrine.

traps.label: A tripwire of braided hair
traps.text: Pulled low and tight across the floorboards, a cord of braided hair catches your boot and takes your foot out from under you.

traps.label: A jaw trap in the stair hall's corner
traps.text: In the dark of the stair hall's corner, heavy iron jaws slam together through the dust.

containers.label: A crate fallen off a cart
A fisher's box on the creek bank
A feed bin by the farm wall

finds.label: A tin jammed under the pump's stone
finds.text: You pry the heavy stone from the mud under the pump, while smoke and straw fly across the lane. Jammed down in the mire sits a tin holdin' a stoppered draught.

finds.label: A tin under the charred floorboards
finds.text: The charred floorboards crack loose under your pry, sendin' up a puff of bitter ash. Down in the soot rests a small tin of silver dust, still warm to the touch.

finds.label: A box bricked into the hearth
finds.text: One brick in the hearth shows a deeper red than its neighbours and slides free with a dry scrape. Behind it waits a small box with a pale pearl inside.

finds.label: An atlas with a hollow spine
finds.text: You pull a heavy atlas from the shelf and feel the hollow give in its leather spine. Tucked inside is a twist of paper heavy with gold dust.

containers.label: A chest at the foot of the bed
A lost farmhand's pack in the stalks
A lost farmhand's pack in the stalks

trap.label: A scythe blade set in the stalks
trap.text: Right beside that lost farmhand's pack, a rusted scythe blade whistles out low through the dry black stalks.

containers.label: A lost farmhand's pack in the stalks

traps.label: A noose of corn husk in the stalks
traps.text: A rough noose of plaited corn husk snaps tight round your ankle with a dry hiss.

traps.label: A pit under the husks
traps.text: The dry husks beneath your boots give way at once, droppin' you toward sharpened stakes in the dark earth.

finds.label: A cache under the stream's bank
finds.text: You reach up under the cold, soot-streaked bank where the dark water laps at the roots. Your fingers close round wet cloth wrapped tight about a black onyx.

traps.label: A tripwire to a rockfall
traps.text: A taut wire catches your boot, and the mountain answers with a roar of loose grey slate slidin' down from above.

trap.label: A poisoned needle in the lock
trap.text: As you work the heavy iron lock, a slick needle springs from the keyhole straight into your thumb.

finds.label: A loose stone in a prayer nook
finds.text: Under the red light of the window and the damp stone faces, one block shifts at your touch. In the cold dust behind it glints a clear diamond.

traps.label: A blood glyph on the larder floor
traps.text: The dried blood painted on the flagstones flares beneath your sole, sendin' a wave of icy rot straight up through your bones.

traps.label: A hound trap in the dirt
traps.text: Rusted iron jaws slam shut in the dirt with a sharp clang, settin' every hound in the kennels to bayin' at once.

finds.label: A box beneath the dried roses
finds.text: You part the heap of brittle, dead roses upon the cold altar stone. Beneath the dry petals rests a smooth lacquered box filled with gold dust.

containers.label: An alms chest by the pews

traps.label: A loose step on the stair
traps.text: The worn stone step tips sharp beneath your boot heel, grinding loose against the curve of the stair.

finds.label: A purse in the blood-soaked rock
finds.text: In the slick, warm rock where the red current runs, you catch a sodden leather purse wedged deep. Inside, ruby dust clings to the damp hide.

containers.label: A tin nailed to a mooring post
A cask of jinxed rum behind the bar

finds.label: A safe under the cabin's boards
finds.text: With green and magenta firelight dancin' across the floorboards, you lift a loose plank in the captain's cabin. Down in the little iron safe sits a single diamond.

containers.label: A box of the house's chips

trap.label: A glass of acid over the lid
trap.text: You lift the lid of the house chip box, and a balanced glass tips its biting, sour liquid straight across your knuckles.

finds.label: A strongbox in the wreck's ribs
finds.text: Down between the slimed oak ribs of the sunken hull, your hand strikes a small iron box. Inside, safe from the dark lagoon water, rests a white pearl.

traps.label: A rotten board on the causeway
traps.text: The slick, rotten plank gives a wet groan and snaps clean in two above the black swamp water.

containers.label: A dry cache in the cypress roots

traps.label: A gator trap in the shallows
traps.text: Beneath the murky shallows, heavy iron teeth slam shut around your leg with a muffled crunch.

finds.label: A purse in the battlefield mud
finds.text: Under the low green fog, you pull a rotted leather purse from the sucking mud. A yellow citrine shines through the mire in your palm.

traps.label: A miner's snare in the ruts
traps.text: Hidden deep in a muddy wagon rut between the wet beeches, an iron wire jerks tight with a sharp metallic twang.

trap.label: A gas bladder rigged to the lid
trap.text: You crack the foreman's lockbox, and a dry pig's bladder bursts inside, puffin' foul green gas into your face.

finds.label: A seam of gold in the drift wall
finds.text: A yellow gleam catches your lamp in the cold rock of the deep drift. You pry the chunk loose, and it crumbles into fine gold dust across your palm.

traps.label: Rotten timbering over a side drift
traps.text: The damp, rotten timbers overhead split with a groan, spillin' a heavy rush of cold earth and stone down into the drift.

traps.label: A covered shaft in the drift floor
traps.text: The mouldering boards beneath your feet splinter at once, opening onto the black draft of an old drop below.

traps.label: A tripwire in the rubble
traps.text: Down in the ankle-deep stone and low green haze, a hidden wire catches your shin and pulls taut.

trap.label: A needle spring in the cabinet door
trap.text: With the low hum of the halls in your ears, a coiled spring in the cabinet door drives a cold needle into your hand.

finds.label: A loose tile in the ward floor
finds.text: One scrubbed floor tile clicks loose under your fingers in the quiet ward. Tucked in the cold mortar underneath waits a pale citrine.

traps.label: A slick ledge over the water
traps.text: Where the purple and teal water laps the curved stone, a coat of copper slime sends your bootsslidin' out from under you.

finds.label: Coins under the dry fountain's owl
finds.text: In the dry basin beneath the stone barn owl, you brush aside dead leaves and tarnished wishing coins. Cool and clean at the bottom lies a single pearl.

containers.label: A heap of offerings at the effigy

traps.label: A rot-filled pit under the moss
traps.text: Under the hollow stare of the branch-woven face, the thick green moss tears away beneath you over a stinking pit of black rot.

containers.label: A druid's chest in a hollow tree

trap.label: A beetle nest under the lid
trap.text: You lift the heavy trunk lid, and a dry, chitterin' mass of dark beetles boils up over your wrists.

finds.label: A cache in the beech's roots
finds.text: Down among the roots of the broad beech, crusted white with damp mould, your hand finds stiff oilcloth. Unwrapped in the gloom, a diamond catches the dim light.

traps.label: A sap-bulb hanging low
traps.text: Overhead in the pale fungal haze, a swollen sap-bulb splits open with a wet pop, spatterin' thick amber jelly down on you.

finds.label: A bucket of coins down the well
finds.text: You haul the rotting rope up from the dark well into the green-white dust of the yard. Down in the slimy wooden bucket rolls a pale pearl.

finds.label: A satchel sunk in the mire
finds.text: From the sour green mire, you drag up a waterlogged leather satchel by its strap. Inside, the wax seal on a glass healing draught holds fast.

containers.label: A pilgrim's pack by the stones

traps.label: An open grave under the mist
traps.text: The pale mist along the road hides the cut earth until your boot steps out over the cold drop of an open grave.

finds.label: A grave gift in a barrow's side
finds.text: While the knotted faces in the bark watch through the damp air, you reach into the grassy flank of the barrow. Your fingers close on the cold edges of a diamond.

containers.label: A mourner's basket left at a grave

traps.label: A grave that gives underfoot
traps.text: Between the leaning rows of wet stone, the sodden turf caves in beneath your weight.

finds.label: A hollow headstone
finds.text: Out among the crowded stones, the cap of one mossy marker lifts free with a grating sound. Inside the hollow stone sits a single cool pearl.

trap.label: A blade in the reliquary's hinge
trap.text: As you open the gilded reliquary under the stone gargoyles, a thin blade snaps out from the hinge.

containers.label: A coffer in a flooded vault

traps.label: A tile over a flooded cellar
traps.text: The flagstones along the drowned lane shift, and one slick tile tips you toward the black cellar water below.

finds.label: A box behind the dark sconce
finds.text: Five iron sconces burn above the great doors, while the sixth sits cold and dark. You reach behind that soot-stained bracket and draw out a small box holdin' a diamond.

containers.label: Grave goods in a side niche

traps.label: A wailing glyph in the hall
traps.text: A pale mark on the stone floor flares under your boot, drivin' a thin, icy wail straight between your ears.

containers.label: An ossuary box in the wall

trap.label: A skull that spits darts
trap.text: You touch the bone box, and a hollow skull set in the wall beside it clicks and spits a flight of iron darts.

finds.label: Coins in a loose skull
finds.text: Among the thousands of dry grins stacked in the dark wall, one yellowing skull turns loose in your hand. Coins and a smooth pearl rattle inside the bone.

traps.label: A floor that sounds hollow
traps.text: The hollow stone beneath your step cracks open like an eggshell over a cluster of waiting stakes.

A mailbag dropped in the scree

finds.label: A bottle washed into the shingle
finds.text: Cold rain patters on the wet shingle where a green glass bottle lies wedged between the stones. Inside the wet glass, a pale pearl rolls with the tide.

traps.label: A gopher hole in the long grass
traps.text: The tall grey-gold grass parts without a sound as your leg drops deep into a hidden burrow.

containers.label: A post crate sunk in the shallows
A prize chest no one has won
A feed bin full of purple slime

finds.label: The tin by the dead tree, still buried
finds.text: Under the quiet, starry sky, the dirt beside the dead tree gives up the old tin just like it used to. Bright gold dust spills warm across your fingers.
